CveFindings.Name: ImageSharp: TIFF CCITT T4 encoder can write past its compressed output buffer
CveFindings.Description:
[CVE-2026-106110](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j9gm-c75j-xc9q): ImageSharp: TIFF CCITT T4 encoder can write past its compressed output buffer

Severity: HIGH

Affected dependencies:
  - SixLabors.ImageSharp:3.1.11 (declared at PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj:16; transitive in PhotoAlbum.Tests/PhotoAlbum.Tests.csproj; resolved inventory: PhotoAlbum.Tests/obj/project.assets.json (not an explicit project declaration)); affected range: >= 2.0.0, < 3.2.0

Recommended fix:
  - Upgrade SixLabors.ImageSharp to 3.2.0 or later within the applicable supported release line.

Dependency inventory match only; application-level exploitability was not tested. Patched-version recommendations use structured GitHub advisory metadata; verify current vendor guidance before upgrading.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Password
CweFindings.Description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.
CweFindings.Explanation: SQL provisioning derives the administrator password from a source-defined literal template and deterministic uniqueString(resource-group ID, environment name). The resulting credential is reproducible from deployment metadata and source rather than secret random input; the credential value is intentionally not reproduced.

CweFindings.Name: Insufficient Logging
CweFindings.Description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.
CweFindings.Explanation: LoginModel.OnPostAsync returns failed authentication results without recording an application security event; the model has no logger or audit integration. Default application configuration suppresses ASP.NET Core informational messages. This is a confirmed logging weakness, not an independently exploitable vulnerability; external monitoring and deployed logging overrides were not verified.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CweFindings.Description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
CweFindings.Explanation: SQL administrator provisioning consumes a credential constructed from a code-defined literal template and deterministic deployment identifiers. A reader of the source with resource-group and environment metadata can reconstruct it. Credential values are withheld.
